Subject: Acme - Redwood pilot discussion & next steps

Alex / Elena:

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: run a two-week pilot of Redwood inference for your customer support summarization flow (up to 10k tokens/session).
- Success criteria: match current quality baseline and 30% reduction in per-ticket inference cost at scale.
- Data: you confirmed logs can be ingested via S3 and we can run in your VPC or on Redwood Dedicated depending on timeline.
- Security: Acme requires SOC 2 evidence and MSA review by legal + procurement.

Agreed next steps:
1) I'll send a short mutual action plan + pilot SOW and a copy of our standard MSA with typical redlines for similar pilots (no commercial exceptions yet) : you should have that by early next week.
2) Alex / Procurement to share target procurement timeline and point person for legal review.
3) If pilot looks good, we'll scope an expanded dedicated deployment and provide pricing options.

Let me know if I mis-summarized anything. I'll follow up with the documents shortly.

Thanks,
Marissa

Alex / Elena / Procurement:

Sending the MSA with our proposed redlines (v3) and a short pilot SOW attached. Highlights:
- No change to standard liability caps beyond mutual carveouts for data processing.
- Confidentiality and data handling language updated to reference VPC option and customer-managed keys.
- Requesting a 45-day payment term for the pilot (open to discussion).

Attachment: Acme-MSA-Redlines-v3.pdf (PDF, 120KB) : includes inline comments (redlines) for counsel.

Jonas Weber (cc) is leading commercial escalation and can jump in on any clause-level questions. Could you confirm receipt and give me an ETA from your counsel on when we might expect feedback?
